Title: Data Factory connector support for Delta Lake and Excel is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory adds connector support to enable Excel sources and enables data flows for Delta Lake both source & sink.

  • Transform, update, upsert, insert, delete rows in data lake files using the Delta file format in data flows .
  • Read from Excel spreadsheets in ADF to work with your business data directly in spreadsheet form.

Learn more
